why: Source: two ratios (or one cross-multiplication), compare, plus one joint no-calculation check of A, B, D (about 4 steps); question: the same two ratios, comparison and joint check of the three data-missing statements (about 4 steps).

Source: four profit-per-unit ratios (pairable by equal counts), one cross-pair comparison, order (about 4 steps); question: the same four ratios with the same pairing, one cross-pair comparison, order (about 4 steps).
Source: read five labelled 2013 bars, sum two groups, apply -20% and +30%, add (about 5 steps); question: read five labelled 2010 bars, sum two groups, apply -30% and +25%, add (about 5 steps).

Source: current profit, 10% volume uplift, tiered cost threshold split into two margins, new profit, difference (about 5 steps); question: identical structure with the same volume uplift and tier threshold (about 5 steps).

Source: read price, cost and consumption off unlabelled dual-axis gridlines, retail profit per car (10 x 30%), per-option profit for four options, compare (about 6 steps); question: the same gridline readings, food profit (5 x 40%), four per-option profits, compare (about 6 steps).

Source: read indices off unlabelled gridlines, check A by comparing rises, compute revenue x margin index for two months, reject B and D (about 5 steps); question: the same readings, A check, May-versus-February profit ratio, reject B and D (about 5 steps).

Source: fixed operations cost in dollars, contribution per premium dollar, break-even premium, percentage increase (4 steps); question: fixed depot cost in dollars, contribution per revenue dollar, break-even revenue, percentage increase (4 steps).

Source: spot the pie's base trap, sum three slices, multiply by the bar share, reject the others (one scaled check plus a no-data check) (about 5 steps); question: the same base trap, three-slice sum, multiply by 26%, the same rejections (about 5 steps).

Source: read two revenue and two market-size values off unlabelled dual-axis gridlines, two share ratios, difference, divide by three years (about 6 steps); question: the same four gridline readings, two shares, difference, divide by three (about 6 steps).

Source: map groups to waterfall bars, sum a three-bar group and take one share, sum a four-bar group and share, two single-bar shares against thresholds (about 5 steps); question: the same mapping, group sums and threshold checks (about 5 steps).
